name: Rommerskirchen (Germany)
description: Green field charged with the shieldless municipal arms of Rommerskirchen, three yellow eagles beneath a yellow crenellated bar.
history: Municipal flag of Rommerskirchen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: three eagles from the municipal arms
